Note for the Green phase: the missing 18 G is the high-enchantment surcharge. The implementation has `cursedSurcharge` folded into `totalItemSurcharges`, so an `enchantmentSurcharge(item)` returning `basePremiumForItem(item) * 0.3` when `enchantment >= 5` slots into the same reduce. Important detail — the surcharge must be based on the item's own base premium (60), not the group/block premium, and the first-insurance surcharge in `premiumBeforeProcessingFee` is computed off `basePremium` only, so it stays at 6 rather than growing with the new surcharge.
